from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from one document regarding its citation relationships."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as provided or extracted")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of the OTHER provided papers that this paper explicitly references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
